name: Argentina
dossier:
The Argentina national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the La Albiceleste, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 2 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from CONMEBOL to this expanded 48-team tournament.

World champions chasing back-to-back glory  -  the team everyone wants to beat.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Argentina will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group J and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group J. The connection between Lautaro Martínez and Julián Álvarez is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Lautaro Martínez - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Argentina are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Reigning champions Argentina arrive in a post-Messi-prime world, defending the crown won in the Qatar epic.
Argentina boast 3 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Champions (1978, 1986, 2022).
